D1.model_visible_rule: A task counts as complete only when both arms are back at the pose they started the episode in.
D1.placement: A separately labeled benchmark-wide rule in planning and execution; retain exact native task instruction.
D1.evaluation: Native full success and separate evaluator-only instructed-goal progress; neither creates policy hints.

D2.action_unit: One per-environment action dictionary; 10 physics substeps per action at frozen 25 Hz collection / 0.004 s physics dt.
D2.controller_mapping: Measure and preregister robot-only tracking, tolerances and timing before a model attempt; do not tune against its task outcome.
D2.termination: Native success at the boundary takes precedence; otherwise horizon_exhausted is a task failure with completion time null. No extra policy action after the boundary.

D3.requires: Versioned rectangular planning grids, grounding schema, geometry validation and video layout; verify actual decoded dimensions and robot-only camera projection before approval.
D3.image_transform: Isaac camera orientation verified directly; no inherited MuJoCo vertical flip.

D4.approval_requirements: Concrete diagnostic layout, capped execution-request/action scope and plumbing-only purpose; approval separate from implementation and from the full pilot.
D4.model_free_checks: Allowed implementation validation after runtime prerequisites; never called an Astra execution test.
D4.whole_attempt_retry: No automatic retry or layout substitution, including zero-action infrastructure failures; a new full attempt needs new review/output and approval.

D5.requires: Recheck availability, bind UUID, verify Kit GPU table and physical CUDA/render device use; do not assume CUDA mask controls Vulkan. Preserve other workloads and host driver.
D5.first_runtime_gate: After license acceptance, isolated model-free RTX camera smoke; preserve a scenedb crash or first-frame hang as a provisioning failure, with no automatic process restart.

E1_correction.review_claim_corrected: The review incorrectly says native arm joint state is overwritten by prev_control. Only keys ending ee_joint_state enter that overwrite.
E1_correction.native_gripper_state: command-derived from prev_control, normalized by gripper scale; not a measured contact or opening certificate
E1_correction.measured_channels: Read both finger joint positions and six arm joint positions/velocities from articulation data, plus measured link6 pose; label raw measurements and any conversions.
E1_correction.command_channels: Keep the requested/latched gripper command separately from measured fingers.

inactive_arm_hold.pose_reference: Freeze the inactive arm measured pose at handoff and maintain that reference on each native action.
inactive_arm_hold.gripper_reference: Retain the last requested gripper command; never replace it with observed opening.
inactive_arm_hold.why: A stale motion target can keep pushing after a stall; echoing observed opening can release a held object.

authorization_note: Implementation authorization does not approve EULA acceptance, a live execution smoke, an uncapped continuation, or the full test start. Later approvals are recorded separately; this file is not a launch approval.
